newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures turn up slightly, trade quiet.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures turn up slightly, trade quiet.

text.p: May 2 - U.S. debt futures turned up slightly in afternoon trade, but action was extremely quiet, traders said. Market eyeing progress on U.S. budget deal. White House official says administration and Republicans nearing an agreement. June T-bond resistance at 109-28/32, 109-30/32, traders said.
